My plot here in Dedza is small, only 0.24 hectares, but maize is what feeds my family so I must do my best with it. I usually get the FISP coupon, so I will use the subsidized NPK at planting and urea for top-dressing, though I cannot afford the full recommended rate. I keep a few chickens and goats, so I add what little manure I can, and I intercrop with pigeon pea or beans like my neighbours do. I will use hybrid seed from the coupon, but I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation — I rely on the rains and my own family's hands, with maybe a few extra days of hired labour at weeding time when the work is heavy.
